description: Set how objects and text print: overprint fill, stroke and gap and Nonprinting on items (Window > Output > Attributes), overprint on text fill and stroke and on paragraph rules, overprint of footnote rules, the [Black] overprint preference, and which layers print (Layer Options > Print Layer)

footnoteRules.description: Overprint of the footnote separator rules (Type > Document Footnote Options > Layout)

continuingRule.description: Overprint the rule above continued footnotes

continuingRuleGap.description: Overprint the gap of the continued footnotes rule

rule.description: Overprint the rule above the first footnote in a column

ruleGap.description: Overprint the gap of that rule

items.description: Attributes panel settings for the target items

nonprinting.description: Nonprinting: the item shows on screen but does not print or export

overprintGap.description: Overprint Gap (of dashed, dotted or striped strokes)

layers.description: Layers to make printable or not (Layer Options > Print Layer)

overprintBlack.description: Overprint the [Black] swatch at 100% (Preferences > Appearance of Black > Overprint [Black] Swatch at 100%)

target.description: Items to set item attributes on. Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

text.description: Text to set text overprint on. Which text to act on. Give storyIds (get_document_stories), frameIds (text frame ids from list_page_items), or selection: true; optionally narrow to a range of paragraphs

frameIds.description: Text frames, by page item id: the text in each frame

paragraphs.description: Only these paragraphs of each text (0-based)

count.description: How many paragraphs (default: to the end)

selection.description: Use the selected text, or the text of the selected text frames

wholeStory.description: Widen frames and selected text to their whole stories

textOverprint.description: Overprint settings for the chosen text

fill.description: Overprint the characters' fill (Attributes > Overprint Fill)

ruleAbove.description: Overprint the paragraph rule above (Paragraph Rules > Overprint Stroke)

ruleAboveGap.description: Overprint the gap of the rule above (Paragraph Rules > Overprint Gap)

ruleBelowGap.description: Overprint the gap of the rule below

stroke.description: Overprint the characters' stroke (Attributes > Overprint Stroke)

name: set_print_attributes
title: Set Print Attributes
